l4Discriminating.text: Synthetic data generation applying mathematical transforms outside physical reality — If 'beats' were a true physical unit of time, scaling both period and frequency upward by 1.50 is mechanically contradictory. Furthermore, the cross-check agreement of 0.440 between pendulum_lab and resonator_obs at a 3-day offset exceeds chance level (0.252), suggesting mathematical coupling or synthetic generation of streams rather than independent physical processes.
